notes: 650M fp32, batch 32 x length 1000 exceeded the 8 GB GPU: the Windows NVIDIA driver spilled into system RAM (136 s per pass, about 11x slower than the 12.6 s expected from 4x the batch-8 result), so it is flagged with exceeds_gpu_memory and excluded from charts.
Batch size 1 results for small models are dominated by CPU kernel-launch overhead, not GPU compute.
